title: Mass in the brane tower
html: In the recursive brane tower (recursive brane tower), mass is not an intrinsic property of a point-particle. Instead, it measures the resistance encountered by a stable vortex propagating through the 1-jet bundle J^1 \mathcal{S}_n (jet prolongation). The substrate parameter q (substrate parameter) varies from fibre to fibre. Translating the vortex along the base therefore forces a corresponding variation of the Frobenius--Hopf structure on each fibre. The mass quantifies this variation.
